name: DABstep
description: A benchmark for evaluating AI agents on realistic multi-step data analysis tasks derived from financial analytics, requiring code-based data processing and contextual reasoning over heterogeneous documentation.
reputation: A recent research benchmark from the financial data-analysis agent literature, but not yet widely established as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Includes a public leaderboard and toolkit; tasks require iterative multi-step problem solving combining code and reasoning.
